subject: End-of-Term Billing: Renewal True-Up and Final Invoice Coordination

Subject: Renewal billing — true-up & end-of-term invoice

Hi Marissa,

We’re getting our books ready for the 2/28 renewal and need a clear final invoice that includes the contract true-up for Q4 overages. Per our records, usage exceeded our committed tokens by ~14% (see internal report) and we expect that to be billed on the end-of-term invoice. A few items to confirm before we complete the PO: 

- Will the overage be rolled into the final invoice or issued as a separate invoice?
- Please confirm VAT treatment — we’re VAT-registered in the UK (GB123456789). I’ve attached our VAT certificate and the PO draft.
- Timeline: we need final invoice and any DocuSign order form by 2/20 to hit our AP cycle.

Can your team confirm amounts (base + overage + VAT) and provide wiring details? If helpful, happy to jump on a quick call — we’re available Thursday afternoon.

Thanks,
Natalie Green
Finance Lead, Finco Corp

Subject: Re: Renewal billing — true-up & end-of-term invoice

Hi Natalie — thanks for the note and for sending the PO and VAT cert. Looping in Vivek (finance) and Logan (legal) so we can align on accounting and the order form.

Short answers up front:
- We can include the true-up on the final end-of-term invoice (preferred), or issue a separate overage invoice if you need it split for your AP — your call.
- Given that Finco is VAT-registered in the UK, we’ll treat the supply per the EU/UK rules; if you confirm the VAT number is valid we can apply reverse-charge where appropriate and omit Redwood VAT. Vivek — can you validate the VAT handling?

Action items for us:
1) I’ll prepare a draft final invoice with the base renewal charge, line-item true-up for overage, and a VAT line (or reverse-charge note) for your review.
2) Logan — please confirm whether any contract language requires an amendment to capture the final overage billing.
3) Natalie — if you can confirm you want the overage on the final invoice (instead of a separate invoice) we’ll proceed that way.

We can do a quick 20-minute call Thursday 2/12 at 3pm GMT if that works — I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole

- Bank instructions (wire):

  - Bank: First Pacific Bank
  - Account: 0123456789
  - SWIFT/BIC: FPACUS33
  - Reference: HS-INV-2891 / Finco PO 345

Attachments: Redwood_Final_Invoice_Draft_20260213.xlsx
